mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_user_club_attendance (user_id, club_id, checkin_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{clubId}, #{checkInTime})
mapper.select:
WITH days AS ( SELECT 1 AS day_num UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 ) SELECT days.day_num AS day_of_week, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sub.week_label = '上周' THEN sub.user_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lNum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sub.week_label = '本周' THEN sub.user_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS tNum FROM days LEFT JOIN ( SELECT
WEEKDAY(checkin_time) + 1 AS day_of_week, CASE WHEN YEARWEEK(checkin_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1) THEN '本周' WHEN YEARWEEK(checkin_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1) - 1 THEN '上周' END AS week_label, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count FROM tbl_user_club_attendance WHERE club_id = #{clubId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND checkout_time IS NOT NULL
AND checkin_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 1 WEEK) AND DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY day_of_week, week_label ) sub ON days.day_num = sub.day_of_week GROUP BY days.day_num ORDER BY days.day_num
